title: Robots Help Make More Toys
story: Toy factories are using robots to help make more toys. Some workers may find new jobs working with these robots.
storyBig: Toy companies are increasing their reliance on automation, leading to changes in the workforce structure. Some employees are transitioning to roles that involve managing and working alongside these advanced technologies.
think: How do robots change the way things are made?
bear: Some people might need new jobs.

rss: Websites taken down worldwide as critical cyber-security update issued
title: Games Offline for Major Update
story: Some online games need to go offline for a super important update. This update will make sure the games are safe and sound.
storyBig: A major cybersecurity update has been deployed, affecting online gaming platforms temporarily. This update aims to rectify significant vulnerabilities, ensuring user safety and data protection.
think: Why is it important to keep games safe online?
bull: The games will be safer after the update!
bear: You might not be able to play your favorite game for a bit.
